Job description
Agency                  Department of Infrastructure and Logistics Work unit             Civil Construction Top End
Job title               Assistant Project Officer                     Designation        Technical 3
Job type                Full Time                                     Duration           Ongoing
Salary                  $84,795 - $92,912                             Location           Palmerston
Position number         27942                 RTF      357758         Closing            12/10/2026
Contact Officer         Justin Rossiter on 08 8999 3463 or Justin.Rossiter@nt.gov.au
About the agency        https://dipl.nt.gov.au/
Apply online            https://jobs.nt.gov.au/Home/JobDetails?rtfId=357758
APPLICATIONS MUST INCLUDE A ONE-PAGE SUMMARY ABOUT YOU, A DETAILED RESUME AND COPIES OF YOUR TERTIARY
QUALIFICATIONS.
Information for applicants – inclusion and diversity and Special Measures recruitment plans
The NTPS values diversity. The NTPS encourages people from all diversity groups to apply for vacancies and accommodates people with
disability by making reasonable workplace adjustments. If you require an adjustment for the recruitment process or job, please discuss
this with the contact officer. For more information about applying for this position and the merit process, go to the OCPE website.
Aboriginal applicants will be granted priority consideration for this vacancy. For more information on Special Measures plans, go to the
OCPE website.
Primary objective
Support the development and delivery of assigned government infrastructure projects to ensure deliverables are achieved. Provide
technical advice regarding civil construction techniques to respective Project Managers.
Context statement
The position works in a project team to undertake assigned projects or programmed works, typically undertaking the duties of Site
Representative, undertaking onsite project quality control and progress monitoring activities.
Key duties and responsibilities
1. Undertake Site Representative duties on projects which include but not limited to releasing hold and witness points, ensuring
   workmanship and materials comply with contract documentation and relevant standards. Ensure adequate conformance testing is
   being undertaken, and conforming results are being achieved. Report any Work Health and Safety, environmental or traffic
   management issues observed on site. Maintain construction records including quantity adjustments and verification, daily diaries and
   photographic records.
2. Undertake asset inspections and review and analyse asset inventory, condition and defect information.
3. Prepare construction proposals and/or maintenance plans and work orders, technical reports, cost estimates; prepare procurement
   and contract documentation for non-complex works to be undertaken.
4. Monitor and report on performance of contractors to the prescribed works and contract regularly to support improvements in
   performance and standards being achieved.
Selection criteria
Essential
1. A relevant qualification awarded by an Australian Institution, or equivalent, or relevant experience in a field of technical work closely
   related to the duties of the vacancy.
2. Good written and oral communication skills including the ability to accurately record construction activities, understand and articulate
   project issues.
3. Knowledge of civil design, construction and maintenance techniques and practices, including roads, land servicing and typical
   environmental management practices.
4. Good information technology skills including word processing and spreadsheet software.
5. Adequate working knowledge of the requirements of the relevant legislation and policies, as applied in the NT as well as a range of
   Australian Standards, Codes of Practice and associated Guidelines.
6. A current NT Driver Licence.
Desirable
1. Certificate in IV Government Procurement or a related field.




Approved: September 2026                                                Claire Brown General Manager Transport and Civil Infrastructure
